Theme

School & learning

educational adjective

that teaches something

also instructive, educational film, educational toy, educational game

modern

Traupman 52: pellicula didascalica, educational film

didascalicus, didascalica, didascalicum

declension

educational, didactic

Greek διδασκαλικός; ante- and post-classical and rare (Didascalica, the title of a work by Accius; Ausonius): Lewis & Short. Traupman’s word in pellicula didascalica, an educational film. A plain description also serves, in a classical construction: ad discendum ūtilis, useful for learning (ūtilis ad with a gerund or noun); ad docendum aptus says the same from the teacher’s side.

Examples

  • Hic lūdus et jūcundus est et ad discendum ūtilis.

    This game is fun and educational.composed

See also education, learn, teach.

SourcesLewis & Short: utilis · Lewis & Short: didascalicus

John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 52.
